description: Segment-level code-mix handling for Hinglish. An utterance is NOT forced into a single language; per-token language metadata is emitted and each script follows its own normalization/script policy.

example.input: Kal meri Google meeting 3 PM pe schedule kar dena
example.note: Romanized Hindi and English share the Latin script; script alone cannot separate them. This pack tags by script and flags the mix; word-level language identity within Latin script is recorded as a known limitation, not guessed.
